archetypes.name: Thermal
archetypes.text: Keep the temperature needle inside the band as it drifts. Hold to heat, release to cool.

archetypes.name: Precision
archetypes.text: Stop the swinging marker on the target line. Three swings.

archetypes.name: Alignment
archetypes.text: Line up the rotating rings so the gaps meet.

archetypes.name: Chemical
archetypes.text: Add reagents in the right order before the mix turns.
